---
title: Visualise a selected event
output: html_document
params:
  df: NA
  event_col: NA
  stratify_by: "cohort"
  plot_type: "Boxplot"
  plot_options: FALSE
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE)
```

```{r run-analysis}
result <- driveanalytics::gen_event_time_analysis(params$df, params$event_col, params$stratify_by, params$plot_type, params$plot_options)
```

# `r description`
## Plot
```{r plot, fig.dim = c(8,8), out.width="100%"}
result$plt
```

## Summary
```{r table, results='asis'}
options(xtable.comment = FALSE)
print(xtable::xtable(result$df), size="\\fontsize{7pt}{8pt}\\selectfont", include.rownames=FALSE)
```
